description: Period costs not tied to an order (advertising, storage, penalties, platform fees, reimbursements) by type and channel; these sit outside SKU P&L margin. Amazon and Flipkart only, on settlement date; default last 30 days.

channel.description: Limit to Amazon or Flipkart. Default: both.

since.description: Start date (ISO, e.g. 2026-10-01, IST day). For "this month" send the 1st of the current month; for "last month" send its 1st with until = its last day. Default: 30 days ago.

until.description: End date (ISO, inclusive IST day). Default: today.
